drafts.invitation:
Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day
Confirmed Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
Current Venue: Multipurpose Hall

Dear Parents and Guardians,

We warmly invite you to attend our upcoming "Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day" at Sunrise Learning Centre, Abuja.

This special educational programme is designed to showcase the wonderful progress our pupils have made in the classroom. It will be a day filled with engaging activities, including simple science demonstrations, storytelling, reading presentations, and creative displays. Our goal is to provide a platform for pupils to demonstrate their learning and to offer parents a deeper insight into our curriculum, encouraging practical learning experiences at home.

Attendance for this event is free. We look forward to celebrating our pupils' achievements with you.

Warm regards,

Mrs Grace Okoro
Headteacher
On behalf of Sunrise Learning Centre
drafts.schedule:
Young Minds: Science, Reading and Creativity Day
Confirmed Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
Current Venue: Multipurpose Hall

Registration: 9:30 AM

Welcome and housekeeping: 10 minutes
Opening remarks by the headteacher: 10 minutes
Pupils’ reading and storytelling presentations: 15 minutes
Science demonstrations: 35 minutes
Refreshment break: 15 minutes
Guided viewing of pupils’ project displays: 30 minutes
Parent and pupil reading activity: 20 minutes
Creativity presentations and recognition of participants: 25 minutes
Vote of thanks: 10 minutes
Closing remarks and supervised departure: 10 minutes

Safety and Supervision:
• Science activities must use simple, low-risk classroom materials. Avoid flames, exposed electrical connections, sharp tools, or experiments involving hazardous chemicals.
• Teachers must supervise all demonstrations, display areas, and pupil movement.
• Parents should remain with younger children during the display tour.
• The designated first-aid officer, Mr Samuel Eze, should be available throughout the programme.
